name: Vie Financial Group, Inc.
summary: Vie Financial Group, Inc. and its subsidiaries provide electronic trading services to institutional investors and broker-dealers in the United States. It offers various trade execution services that are provided through the company's broker-dealer subsidiary Vie Securities, LLC. The company offers algorithms used by its customers to obtain the volume-weighted average price (VWAP). It offers Full-Day VWAP, Limit VWAP, Point-to-Point VWAP, Best Efforts VWAP, RapidEx, Market on Open and Market on Close, Pairs, Statistical Price Predictive Methods, 10b-18 Algorithm, and Post-Trade Performance Measurement. The company's products are used by brokers to reduce information leakage. It sells its products through an online transaction and distribution system. Vie Financial Group, Inc. was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
